Name: 黄金魔女
Title: 虚假的黄金梦
Description: 她相信金币是真的，也相信梦里的金币足够锋利。真正危险的是醒来之后，账本仍然记得你的名字。
Description_zh-Hant: 她相信金幣是真的，也相信夢裡的金幣足夠鋒利。真正危險的是醒來之後，帳本仍然記得你的名字。
Description_en: She believes real gold is real, and dream-gold can still cut. The danger is that the ledger remembers after waking.
Action1: <name>点金梦契</name><des>支付25金币，获得5层{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}并抽1张牌。金币不足时，改为获得4层{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}和3层{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}。</des><cd>CD:3</cd>
Action1_zh-Hant: <name>點金夢契</name><des>支付25金幣，獲得5層{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}並抽1張牌。金幣不足時，改為獲得4層{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}和3層{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}。</des><cd>CD:3</cd>
Action1_en: <name>Midas Dream Pact</name><des>Pay 25 gold, gain 5 {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}, and draw 1. If you cannot pay, gain 4 {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} and 3 {GoldExp_goldexp_debt}.</des><cd>CD:3</cd>
Action2: <name>黄金清算</name><des>消耗所有{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，对敌方全体造成10+伪金*3点伤害。若有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，清算一半债务。</des><cd>CD:4</cd>
Action2_zh-Hant: <name>黃金清算</name><des>消耗所有{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，對敵方全體造成10+偽金*3點傷害。若有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，清算一半債務。</des><cd>CD:4</cd>
Action2_en: <name>Golden Audit</name><des>Spend all {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} to deal 10 + 3 per stack to all enemies. If you have {GoldExp_goldexp_debt}, settle half of it.</des><cd>CD:4</cd>
Passive1: <name>虚假的黄金梦</name><des>战斗开始时，获得当前金币/60的{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，最多8层。每场战斗第一次真实金币增加时，额外获得增加量/20的{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}。战斗结束时清空伪金并清算债务。</des>
Passive1_zh-Hant: <name>虛假的黃金夢</name><des>戰鬥開始時，獲得當前金幣/60的{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，最多8層。每場戰鬥第一次真實金幣增加時，額外獲得增加量/20的{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}。戰鬥結束時清空偽金並清算債務。</des>
Passive1_en: <name>False Golden Dream</name><des>At combat start, gain {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} equal to gold/60, max 8. The first time real gold increases each combat, gain extra {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} equal to the increase/20. At combat end, clear False Gold and settle Debt.</des>
Passive1_ja: <name>偽りの黄金夢</name><des>戦闘開始時、偽金を得る。</des>
